source.title: Forebears Namibia forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables support representative Namibian names. This is not an official civil registry export; gender grouping remains a review seed.

source.title: ITU Namibia national numbering plan communication of 12.VII.2018

phones.notes: ITU/CRAN confirms country code +264, nine-digit 83, 84 and 85 electronic-communications allocations. Prefix 81 was removed because it was not in the reviewed ITU allocation table.

locations.notes: NamPost confirms current five-digit postal codes including Khomas/Windhoek and Erongo/Walvis Bay ranges. Streets remain representative review samples; postalPrefixes are generator prefixes, not complete postcodes.

national_identity_number.label: National Identity Number
national_identity_number.notes: The Act states an identity number consists of eleven figures. No public checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed, so generation is random digits only.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: PRADO confirms Namibian passport document families. The public listing does not confirm passport-number grammar; template remains synthetic.
